description: This file is a Python source script that defines deprecated utility functions for generating type hints for DataPipes in PyTorch, including functions for materializing lines, generating from templates, and parsing method signatures. It also contains logic for discovering relevant files and generating interface definitions for DataPipes, with specific focus on 'iter' and 'map' DataPipes.

methods.name: materialize_lines
methods.description: Deprecated function to join lines with indentation, producing a string.

methods.name: gen_from_template
methods.description: Deprecated function to generate files from templates with replacements.

methods.name: find_file_paths
methods.description: Finds Python files in given directories, excluding specified files.

methods.name: extract_method_name
methods.description: Extracts method name from a decorator line.

methods.name: extract_class_name
methods.description: Extracts class name from a class definition line.

methods.name: parse_datapipe_file
methods.description: Parses a DataPipe Python file to extract method signatures, class names, and docstrings.

methods.name: parse_datapipe_files
methods.description: Parses multiple DataPipe files to aggregate method signatures and related info.

methods.name: split_outside_bracket
methods.description: Splits a line by commas outside brackets.

methods.name: process_signature
methods.description: Cleans up raw function signatures, removing self, default args, and spaces.

methods.name: get_method_definitions
methods.description: Generates method signature strings for DataPipes, including docstrings and output types.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function to generate interface files for 'iter' and 'map' DataPipes and write to templates.
